name: High-Field 3T Brain MRI
description: Ultra-high resolution neurovascular scan with diffusion tensor imaging and vascular flow dynamics.
preparationNotes: Strictly no metallic implants or ferromagnetic objects. Fast 2 hours prior.

name: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP-14)
description: Evaluation of kidney function, liver enzymes, electrolytes, blood glucose, and protein balance.
preparationNotes: 10-hour overnight fasting required. Water intake encouraged.

name: 128-Slice Cardiac CT Angiography
description: Non-invasive visualization of coronary lumen, calcium scoring, and hemodynamic stenosis assessment.
preparationNotes: Avoid caffeine 12 hours prior. Beta-blockers may be administered if resting HR > 65 bpm.

name: Digital 12-Lead ECG & Rhythm Telemetry
description: Instantaneous cardiac electrical axis tracing with automated ST-segment and QTc interval analysis.
preparationNotes: No special preparation. Wear two-piece clothing.

name: Targeted Oncologic Genomic Panel
description: Next-generation sequencing (NGS) screening for 52 actionable somatic tumor mutations.
preparationNotes: Coordinated with attending oncology team following blood draw or biopsy tissue submission.

name: High-Resolution Musculoskeletal Ultrasound
description: Dynamic real-time acoustic assessment of tendon tears, bursitis, effusions, and ligament integrity.
preparationNotes: Expose affected joint area; no fasting needed.

name: Pulmonary Function Test (Spirometry + DLCO)
description: Comprehensive measurement of lung volumes, airway resistance, and gas diffusion capacity.
preparationNotes: Withhold short-acting bronchodilator inhalers 6 hours prior to testing.

name: Complete Blood Count with Automated Diff (CBC)
description: Full hematologic breakdown of leukocytes, erythrocytes, hemoglobin, hematocrit, and platelet indices.
